spans.s: नमत [namata], a. [नम्-अतच्] Bent, bowed, crooked, curved.

नमसित [namasita] नमस्यित [namasyita], नमस्यित a. Revered, respected, saluted.

; but with कृ, generally with acc.; मुनित्रयं नमस्कृत्य Sk.; but sometimes with dat. also; नमस्कुर्मो नृसिंहाय ibid. The word has the sense of a noun, but is treated as an indeclinable.)
A sacrifice.-Comp. -कारः, -कृतिः f. -करणम् bowing, respectful or reverential salutation, respectful obeisance (made by uttering the word नमस्). -कारी a kind of plant (Mar. लाजाळू). -कृत a.

Entitled to obeisance, revered, respectable, adorable; ब्रह्मन्नतिथिनर्मस्यः Kaṭh. Up.; ब्राह्मणा मे महाभागा नमस्याः पुरुषर्षभाः
Respectful, humble.-स्या Worship, adoration, reverence, obeisance; प्रियायास्मै धाम्ने प्रविहितनमस्यो$स्मि भवते
To bow down to, pay homage to, worship; नमस्यामो देवान् ननु हतविधेस्ते$पि वशगाः
नामित [nāmita], a. Bent, bowed down &c.; नामितं नु गगनं स्थगितं नु
N. of a demon slain by Indra; वनमुचे नमुचेररये शिरः

. [When Indra conquered the Asuras, there was only one called Namuchi who strongly resisted and at last captured him. He offered to let Indra go provided he promised 'not to kill by day or by night, with wet or dry'. Indra promised to do so and was released, but he cut off Namuchi's head at twilight and with foam of water (which is neither wet nor dry). According to another version Namuchi was a friend of Indra, and once drank up his strength and made him quite imbecile. The Aśvins (and Sarasvatī also, as the story goes) then supplied Indra with a Vajra with which he cut off the demon's head].
N. of the god of love. -Comp. -सूदनः, -द्विष्, -हन् m. epithets of Indra; विगृह्य चक्रे नमुचिद्विषा बली य इत्थमस्वास्थ्यमहर्निशं दिवः Śi.1.51.
नमेरुः [namēruḥ], N. of a tree (रुद्राक्ष or सुरपुन्नाग); गणा नमेरुप्रसवाव- तंसा
नम् [nam], 1 P., sometimes Ā. (नमति-ते, ननाम, अनंसीत्, नंस्यति, नत, caus. नमयति-ते or नामयति-ते, but with a preposition नमयति only; desid. निनंसति) also 9 P. (नम्नाति), 4. P. (नम्यति)
To bow to, make obeisance to, salute (as a mark of respect) (with acc. or dat.); इयं नमति वः सर्वान् त्रिलोचनवधूरिति

To bend, sink; go down; अनंसीद्भूर्भरेणास्य
To change a dental to a lingual letter. -Caus.
To bend (as a bow); न नमयितुमधिज्यमस्मि शक्तः Ś.2.3.
To subdue, make subordinate; स पुरस्कृतमध्यमक्रमो नमयामास नृपाननुद्धरन्
नम्य [namya], , also -नमनीय a. Venerable, respectable; त्वमर्थानां मूलं धनदनमनीयाङ्घ्रिकमले Ā.
नाम्य [nāmya], a. Pliable, flexible, pliant; क्षत्रियेण धनुर्नाम्यम्
Bowing, bowing down, bent, inclined, hanging down; भवन्ति नम्रास्तरवः फलागमैः Ś.5.12. स्तोकनम्रा स्तनाभ्याम्
Bowing down, making a low obeisance; अभूत् च नम्रः प्रणिपातशिक्षया
Lowly, submissive, humble, reverential; as in भक्तिनम्रः
Devoted or attached to. -Comp. -अङ्ग, -मूर्ति a. bent, stooping. -नासिक a. flat-nosed.
नम्रक [namraka], a. Bent, stooping. -कः kind of reed.
नम्रित [namrita], a. Bent or bowed down, stooping.
नाम [nāma], ind. A particle used in the following senses:
Named, called, by name; हिमालयो नाम नगाधिराजः
Indeed, certainly, truly, forsooth, verily, to be sure; मया नाम जितम्
.; विनीतवेषेण प्रवेष्टव्यानि तपोवनानि नाम Ś.1; आश्वासितस्य मम नाम
'when I was just consoled'; तन्नाम निष्ठुराः पुरुषाः
Probably, perhaps; oft. with मा' अये पदशब्द इव मा नाम रक्षिणः
'herhaps (but I hope not) that of guards'; मा नाम अकार्यं कुर्यात्
; त्वया नाम मुनिर्विमान्यः Ś.5.2 'is it possible &c.' (implying censure); frequently used with अपि in the sense of 'I wish', 'would that', 'is it likely that &c.'; see under अपि
A feigned or pretended action, pretence (अलीक); कार्न्तान्तिको नाम भूत्वा
; so भीतो नामावप्लुत्य 14 'as if afraid', परिश्रमं नाम विनीय च क्षणम्
(With imperatives) Granted, though, it may be, well, it may be; तद् भवतु नाम शोकावेगाय
; एवं नामास्तु 'be it so, if you like'; करोतु नाम नीतिज्ञो व्यवसायमितस्ततः
Anger or censure; ममापि नाम दशाननस्य परैः परिभवः G. M.; (the sentence may imply 'censure' also किं नाम विस्फुरन्ति शस्त्राणि
Wonder; आश्चर्यमन्धो नाम पुत्रं द्रक्ष्यति Sk.
Recollection. नाम is often used with the interrogative pronoun and its derivatives कथम्, कदा &c. in the sense of 'possibly', 'indeed', 'I should like to know'; अयि कथं नामैतत्
; को नाम पाकाभिमुखस्य जन्तुर्द्वाराणि दैवस्य पिधातुमीष्टे
नामक [nāmaka], (At the end of adj. comp.) = नामन्; as कृतनामक.

'not even the name, i. e. no trace or mark is seen' &c.;
